text: Vehicles in Sri Lanka have **long white front** plates and **short yellow rear** plates.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡的車輛有 **長的白色前車牌** 和 **短的黃色後車牌**。

text: In most Generation 3 coverage, you will be able to see the **front of the Google car** partially through the blur: it is visible as blue-white-red patches, reminiscent of the French flag. The red patch is usually most visually distinct.
NOTE: This car is unique to Sri Lanka. Coverage in Ghana has a similar front of the car visible, but this coverage also has a roof rack.
text_zh: 在大多數第三代街景中，你將能夠透過模糊效果部分看到 **Google 車的前方**：它顯示為藍-白-紅色的色塊，讓人聯想起法國國旗。紅色色塊通常在視覺上最為明顯。
注意：這輛車是斯里蘭卡特有的。迦納的街景也有類似可見的車頭，但該街景還帶有車頂架。

text: All Generation 4 coverage is **low-cam**. This means that the camera on the Google car is intentionally set up lower than in most other countries. This can be recognized in two ways:
- The car blur is significantly bigger. Generally, the bigger car blur is the most consistent way to recognize low-cam.
- Roads look wider and objects around you are seen from a lower angle.
Note that Sri Lanka’s Generation 3 coverage is made with a normal height camera!
NOTE: All coverage in Japan and Switzerland is low-cam. However, landscape should be sufficient to tell these apart from Sri Lanka.
text_zh: 所有第四代街景都是 **低相機視角（low-cam）**。這意味著 Google 車上的相機故意設置得比大多數其他國家還要低。這可以透過兩種方式辨識：
- 車輛模糊範圍明顯更大。通常，較大的車輛模糊是辨識低相機視角最一致的方法。
- 道路看起來更寬，你周圍的物體是以更低的視角被看見。
請注意，斯里蘭卡的第三代街景是用正常高度的相機拍攝的！
注意：日本和瑞士的所有街景都是低相機視角。然而，地景應該足以將它們與斯里蘭卡區分開來。

text: In Sri Lanka, you will see two scripts: **Sinhala** and **Tamil**. You will also sometimes see English, written in Latin script.
Sinhala is most common, and can be found throughout the entire country. It has a very curvy, ‘rounded’ look.
Tamil is more regionally limited. It has straighter lines. For an exact distribution, see the region-guessing section.
NOTE: Sinhala is unique to Sri Lanka. However, Tamil can also be found in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
text_zh: 在斯里蘭卡，你會看到兩種文字：**僧伽羅文（Sinhala）** 和 **泰米爾文（Tamil）**。你 parfois 也會看到用拉丁字母書寫的英文。
僧伽羅文最為常見，遍布全國各地。它具有非常流暢、「圓潤」的外觀。
泰米爾文的區域限制較多。它的線條更直。如需確切分布，請參閱區域猜測章節。
注意：僧伽羅文是斯里蘭卡特有的。然而，泰米爾文也可以在印度泰米爾納德邦找到。

text: Sri Lanka typically uses **concrete utility poles**. Two pole types are common and distinctive:
- [Square poles](https://goo.gl/maps/i36FFgx1jfjK7pf77) with small pinholes in the sides. These pinholes are limited to the top part of the pole.
- Poles with large [see-through holes](https://goo.gl/maps/UZTouXphP9iE3Wh9A) in the lower half of the pole (“holey poles“). These poles are unique to Sri Lanka.
NOTE: The square poles with small pinholes can look very similar to those found in Thailand. However, in Thailand the pinholes extend all the way to the bottom of the pole.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡通常使用 **混凝土電線桿**。兩種電線桿類型很常見且具有獨特辨識度：
- 側面帶有小針孔的 [方形電線桿](https://goo.gl/maps/i36FFgx1jfjK7pf77)。這些針孔僅限於電線桿的頂部。
- 電線桿下半部帶有大型 [穿透孔](https://goo.gl/maps/UZTouXphP9iE3Wh9A) 的電線桿（「多孔電線桿」）。這些電線桿是斯里蘭卡特有的。
注意：帶有小針孔的方形電線桿看起來可能非常類似於泰國的電線桿。然而，在泰國，針孔一直延伸到電線桿底部。

text: These short, wide **stone bollards** are unique to Sri Lanka. They have a tapered shape, with a black base and a white top.
text_zh: 這些矮而寬的 **石製路樁** 是斯里蘭卡特有的。它們呈錐形，底部為黑色，頂部為白色。

text: Tall, white concrete waystones with an indented section near the bottom containing a yellow road number, are unique to Sri Lanka.
text_zh: 高大的白色混凝土界石，其底部附近有一個凹陷區塊，裡面寫著黃色的道路編號，這是斯里蘭卡特有的。

text: Sri Lanka commonly uses **black and white** striped signposts.
NOTE: Within South and Southeast Asia, such signposts are also found in Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Malaysia.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡普遍使用 **黑白相間** 的標誌柱。
注意：在南亞和東南亞境內，孟加拉、不丹、印度、尼泊爾和馬來西亞也能找到這樣的標誌柱。

text: Rural roads often have **outside lines, but no middle lines**. In the absence of other clues, this can sometimes be a way to decide a tough 50-50.
NOTE: Most small roads lack road lines entirely.
text_zh: 鄉村道路通常有 **外側線，但沒有中線**。在缺乏其他線索的情況下，這有時可以成為在艱難的五五波（50-50）抉擇中做出判斷的方法。
注意：大多數小路完全沒有道路標線。

text: Sri Lanka is a **tropical** country. It usually has very lush, green vegetation. It is densely populated and many parts are covered in a patchwork of agricultural fields.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡是一個 **熱帶** 國家。它通常擁有非常茂盛的綠色植被。它人口稠密，許多地方都被拼布般的農田所覆蓋。

text: Many parts of Sri Lanka have **reddish soil**.
Less commonly, you may encounter [white, sandy soil](https://goo.gl/maps/AcNaEq3fgrBK4M7p7).
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡的許多地方都有 **紅土**。
較不常見的是，你可能會遇到 [白色的沙質土壤](https://goo.gl/maps/AcNaEq3fgrBK4M7p7)。

text: **Palm trees** are very common in Sri Lanka, more so than many other Asian countries.
NOTE: Palm trees are also very common in the Philippines.
text_zh: **棕櫚樹** 在斯里蘭卡非常普遍，比許多其他亞洲國家更常見。
注意：棕櫚樹在菲律賓也非常普遍。

text: Houses often have **orange or red tiled roofs**. Due to wear and tear, these tiles often have an almost brown tint to them.
NOTE: Similar roofs are also common in parts of Indonesia.
text_zh: 房屋通常有 **橘色或紅色的瓦片屋頂**。由於磨損，這些瓦片通常帶有幾乎是棕色的色調。
注意：類似的屋頂在印尼的部分地區也很常見。

text: The country is majority **Buddhist**: 70% of the population practise this religion. Throughout the country, you will often see signs of the religion, including temples, Buddha statues, [stupas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stupa) and the [Buddhist flag](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag).
NOTE: Thailand, Cambodia and Laos are also majority Buddhist.
text_zh: 這個國家大多數人口信仰 **佛教**：70% 的人口實踐這種宗教。在全國各地，你經常會看到這種宗教的跡象，包括寺廟、佛像、[佛塔](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stupa) 以及 [佛教旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag)。
注意：泰國、柬埔寨和寮國也多數信仰佛教。

text: A substantial minority of the population adhere to **other religions**: Hinduism (13%), Islam (10%) and Christianity (7%). These religions have strong regional distribution patterns; see the region-guessing section for more information.
text_zh: 相當一部分少數人口信仰 **其他宗教**：印度教（13%）、伊斯蘭教（10%）和基督教（7%）。這些宗教具有強烈的區域分布模式；欲了解更多資訊，請參閱區域猜測章節。

text: This style of **tuktuk** is common in Sri Lanka: it has a bulky shape and a black roof. They are usually coloured green, yellow or red, though other colours appear as well.
text_zh: 這種風格的 **嘟嘟車（tuktuk）** 在斯里蘭卡很常見：它具有笨重的外形和黑色的車頂。它們通常被漆成綠色、黃色或紅色，不過也會出現其他顏色。

text: Google used a weird, low-quality camera in Sri Lanka. This camera is known as the official Ari (or “Shitcam”). It has a wide circular car blur and often somewhat brownish colours. A good map will not usually include this coverage, but it is good to be aware of its existence, in order to not be caught off-guard by it.
NOTE: Other tropical countries with shitcam include India, Cambodia, Ecuador and to a lesser extent Bangladesh.
text_zh: Google 在斯里蘭卡使用了一個奇怪且低品質的相機。這款相機被稱為官方的 Ari（或「爛相機／Shitcam」）。它有著寬大的圓形車輛模糊，且顏色通常有點偏棕色。優秀的地圖通常不會包含這種街景，但了解它的存在是好的，以免被它殺個措手不及。
注意：其他擁有爛相機的熱帶國家包括印度、柬埔寨、厄瓜多，以及程度較輕的孟加拉。

text: Sri Lankan telephone numbers have 10 digits.
The first three digits of landline phone numbers are the **area code**. The first digit of that area code is always a 0, while the remaining two digits are shown on the map.
Mobile phone numbers always start with 07 and are not associated with any particular region.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Image credit: Maccem._
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡的電話號碼有 10 位數。
固定電話號碼的前三碼是 **區碼**。該區碼的第一個數字永遠是 0，而其餘兩個數字則顯示在地圖上。
手機號碼永遠以 07 開頭，且與任何特定區域無關。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。圖片來源：Maccem。_

text: These maps shows the distribution of each of Sri Lanka’s **four main religions**. This can help with region-guessing when you spot a house of worship or other symbol associated with one of the religions.
- Buddhism is found in most of the country but is mostly absent from the north and some parts of the east coast.
- Hinduism is predominantly found in the north and parts of the east, as well as around the town of Nuwara Eliya in the central mountains.
- Islam is strongest on the east coast, but not a majority in any district.
- Christianity is mostly confined to the northwest, and is strongest around the town of Mannar.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這些地圖顯示了斯里蘭卡 **四大主要宗教** 的分布。當你發現寺廟或與其中一種宗教相關的其他符號時，這有助於進行區域猜測。
- 佛教見於該國大部分地區，但在北部和東海岸的部分地區幾乎不存在。
- 印度教主要見於北部和東部部分地區，以及中部山區的努沃勒埃利耶（Nuwara Eliya）城鎮周圍。
- 伊斯蘭教在東海岸最強勢，但在任何地區都不是多數。
- 基督教主要限於西北部，在馬納爾（Mannar）城鎮周圍最強勢。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The presence of the **Tamil script** is strongly correlated with the distribution of Hinduism (though not all Tamils are Hindu and vice versa).
There are two groups that use the Tamil script:
- Native Sri Lankan Tamils, who predominantly live in the north and the east.
- Indian Tamils, who mostly live in and around the central Nuwara Eliya district.

Note that it is not uncommon to find bilingual Sinhala and Tamil signs far outside the area where Tamil is the predominant language. However, Tamil-only signage can be a strong indicator for one of the Tamil-majority areas.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **泰米爾文** 的存在與印度教的分布有強烈的相關性（儘管並非所有泰米爾人都是印度教徒，反之亦然）。
有兩個群體使用泰米爾文：
- 本地斯里蘭卡泰米爾人，主要居住在北部和東部。
- 印度泰米爾人，主要居住在中部努沃勒埃利耶地區及其周圍。
請注意，在泰米爾語為主要語言的區域之外，發現雙語的僧伽羅文和泰米爾文標誌並不罕見。然而，純泰米爾文標誌可能是泰米爾人多數地區的強烈指標。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: This map shows Sri Lanka’s **topography**. Hills and mountains are strongly concentrated in the central-southern part of the country.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這張地圖顯示了斯里蘭卡的 **地形**。丘陵和山脈高度集中在中南部地區。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The southwest of Sri Lanka has a more **wet climate** that is characterised by lush, dense vegetation. Deep green tones dominate the landscape.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡西南部擁有更 **濕潤的氣候**，其特徵是繁茂、濃密的植被。深綠色調主導了地景。

text: Conversely, the rest of the country has a slightly more **dry climate**. The vegetation is often lower and more open. The landscape usually has a mix of brown and green tones.

Note that the difference is not extreme, as the landscape in Sri Lanka never truly gets downright arid. However, with some practise, you can often learn to tell the difference. Your mileage may also vary depending on the season, local forest cover, or coverage type (Generation 3 often tends to make the landscape look more arid than it really is).
text_zh: 相反地，該國其餘地區擁有稍微更 **乾燥的氣候**。植被通常較低且較為開闊。地景通常融合了棕色和綠色調。
請注意，這種差異並非極端，因為斯里蘭卡的景觀從未真正變得完全乾旱。然而，經過一些練習，你通常可以學會分辨其中的差異。你的體驗也可能因季節、當地森林覆蓋率或街景類型而異（第三代街景通常會讓景觀看起來比實際更乾燥）。

text: **Tea plantations** are found in the central and southwestern parts of the country. They are most common in the area just west of Nuwara Eliya.
Tea plants look like small, compact shrubs with bright green leaves. They are usually planted in organised rows or clusters on hillsides.
text_zh: **茶園** 分布在中部和西南部地區。它們在努沃勒埃利耶正西方的地區最為常見。
茶樹看起來像是小型、緊密的灌木，有著鮮綠色的葉子。牠們通常以整齊的行或叢狀種植在山坡上。

text: **Horton Plains National Park **has a very distinct and bait landscape, consisting of hilly plains covered in long grass. In the distance, you can see forests, but most of the park’s roads meander through a wide open landscape.
text_zh: **霍頓平原國家公園**有著非常獨特且具標誌性的地貌，由長滿長草的丘陵平原組成。在遠處可以看到森林，但公園的大多數道路都蜿蜒穿過寬廣開闊的地貌。
